name: Bucket
subtitle: Personal builds of Bucket for iPhone

apps.name: Bucket
apps.subtitle: Date ideas and a shared bucket list for Singapore
apps.localizedDescription: Discover things to do in Singapore, keep a bucket list with your partner or friends, plan dates, and save the memories.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Bucket attaches your photos and videos to memories.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bucket lets you snap a photo for a memory.
privacy.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Bucket adds your planned dates to your calendar.

versions.localizedDescription:
- README and plan: push setup, tests, signing
- Push notifications on iOS: token registration, tap routing, settings toggles; reset tab on sign-out
- Offline caching with offline banner; no group-setup flash after sign-in
- Year in review stories with shareable summary
- Emoji reactions on photos and videos; search and filter chips
- Milestones with badge grid and one-time celebrations
- Group types, together-since date, monthsaries, anniversaries and birthdays
- Tap to dismiss keyboard; edit a memory's place and date
- Plan: push settings in Vault
- Push notifications server side: push-send function, cron, Vault settings, tests
- Schema for memory places, group types, birthdays, reactions and push outbox; plan
- Faster uploads with live progress, dated memories, own-idea locations, battery work
- Add reminders, widgets, events, venue map pins and email sender setup

- Switch to email/password and Google sign-in
- Pipeline: stricter Places matching, Gemini fallback, renamed venues

- Add SideStore release script and source
- Add weather-aware discover, venues, plans with calendar export, map and videos
- Add data pipeline: NEA weather, Google Places enrichment, Gemini ideas
- Add media-sign edge function, IPA build script and README
- Add SwiftUI app: OTP sign-in, groups, discover, bucket list, memories, themes
- Match migration version to remote project
- Add Supabase schema, RLS, discovery RPC and seed catalogue
